item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera heats some dry sugar in a dry boiling tube in her school laboratory. A black solid is left behind and droplets of water collect on the cooler parts of the tube. Which statement does not correctly use these observations to conclude that sugar is a compound?

options.A: The black solid is carbon, so sugar must contain the element carbon.
options.B: The water formed contains hydrogen and oxygen, so these elements must have come from the sugar.
options.C: The water droplets must have come from the air, so they tell us nothing about the elements in sugar.
options.D: Sugar breaks down on heating into simpler substances, which shows it is made of more than one element.
